pre_tool_use.command: for d in "${OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHARNESS_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.openharness}/plugins/guard" "$PWD/.openharness/plugins/guard"; do if [ -f "$d/hooks/guard_hook.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/hooks/guard_hook.py"; fi; done; echo "[guard] 未找到 guard_hook.py，已跳过拦截；请设置 OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT" >&2; exit 0

post_tool_use.command: for d in "${OPENHARNESS_GUARD_ROOT:-}" "${OPENHARNESS_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.openharness}/plugins/guard" "$PWD/.openharness/plugins/guard"; do if [ -f "$d/hooks/guard_audit.py" ]; then exec python3 "$d/hooks/guard_audit.py"; fi; done; echo "[guard] 未找到 guard_audit.py，已跳过审计" >&2; exit 0
